svg.title: Predicting evolved correlations from an ancestral DFE
svg.desc: Illustrative pipeline: fit the ancestral distribution of fitness effects, simulate adaptive walks, measure simulated mutation effects on ancestral and evolved backgrounds, add measurement error to the fitness effects, calculate correlations for all mutations and the bulk, and predict future correlations with no additional fit. All curves and data marks are schematic.

tspan.tspan: Add noise to fitness effects, calculate correlations

g.inkscape:label: Measurement error on simulated fitness effects
